title: Patching LG G Watch W100 care pack, now stuck on boot
body:
I installed the care pack for my G Watch (build M1D65S). Patching ~~worked without any problems but~~ throws an error and now it just shows the LG boot screen forever.

I applied the patch manually in the adb shell and get an error when patching with xdelta3. The checksum is incorrect and patching stops. By adding the no-checksum-option I'm able to apply the patch but the result is the same. The watch hangs at the boot image.

The logs that are available in recovery mode don't show any errors.

I can still boot into fastboot and restore the original system image.
